The '''Galleon''' was the unarmed predecessor of the [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]].

==History==
The class was first used in the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it continued to be used in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although difficult to compare, the game stats in [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] depict the Galleon as a slow and fragile transport equipped with weak shields and a class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that would be able to transport about two [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]].<ref name="SWR-VG">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>
